def add_book(conn, title, author, year=None):
    """Add a book and return its id."""
    with conn:
        if author:
            trimmed_author = author.strip()
            if trimmed_author != '':
                cur = conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO authors (name) VALUES (?)", (trimmed_author,))
                author_id = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM authors WHERE name = ?", (trimmed_author,)).fetchone()[0]
            else:
                author_id = None
        else:
            author_id = None

        if author_id:
            cur = conn.execute("INSERT INTO books (title, author_id, year) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (title, author_id, year))
        else:
            cur = conn.execute("INSERT INTO books (title, author_id, year) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (title, None, year))
    return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef find_by_author(conn, name):
    """Titles of the books by the author called exactly name, sorted."""
    rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT b.title 
        FROM books b 
        JOIN authors a ON b.author_id = a.id 
        WHERE a.name = ? 
        ORDER BY b.title
    """, (name,))
    return [r[0] for r in rows]\n\n\ndef list_books(conn):
    """(id, title, author, year) for every book, sorted by title then id."""
    return conn.execute("""
        SELECT b.id, b.title, a.name, b.year 
        FROM books b 
        LEFT JOIN authors a ON b.author_id = a.id 
        ORDER BY b.title, b.id
    """).fetchall()\n\n\ndef books_per_author(conn):
    """A list of (author_name, book_count) for authors with at least one book, most books first, ties by name."""
    rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT a.name, COUNT(b.id) 
        FROM authors a 
        JOIN books b ON a.id = b.author_id 
        GROUP BY a.id 
        ORDER BY COUNT(b.id) DESC, a.name ASC
    """)
    return [r for r in rows]
